expected_behavior: Derives the target major v15 from the full version 15.16.0 and follows the v15 path; confirms cypress is on the 14.x prerequisite.
Resolves the install target to the exact version 15.16.0.
Flags Node 18 (from .nvmrc) as an install blocker (v15 requires 20, 22, or 24+).
Flags Vite 4 as below the minimum supported Vite 5.
Flags Angular 17 as below the component-testing minimum of 18.0.0.
Flags zone.js 0.13 as below the required 0.14.0.
Flags webpack 4 as no longer supported.
Identifies the CommonJS cypress.config.js using @cypress/vite-dev-server as an ESM-only violation and recommends moving the config to an ESM context.
Updates the 3-argument cy.stub(user, 'getName', fn) to cy.stub(user, 'getName').callsFake(fn).
Flags the querystring import as a built-in no longer shimmed by the batteries-included preprocessor.
Notes the glibc (< 2.31) and macOS checks are environment-dependent and reports them.
Halts before installing because of the Node install blocker rather than silently proceeding.
